findings.failure_path: The stated gate prohibits any success-count decrease of two or more, but the recorded result includes 10 → 8. Calling this passing by switching to failure counts after observing the results changes the acceptance metric. Exclusions explain the decrease but do not establish passage of the original gate.
findings.smallest_fix: Mark the original gate unmet or inconclusive, retain the denominator explanation, and make acceptance of the revised comparison an explicit decision.

findings.failure_path: The claimed two wording-only differences do not reconcile the evaluated and landing text. The frozen architecture addition is 943 bytes and the product router shrinks by 37, giving a net 906-byte increase for the described three-entrypoint bundle, versus the reported 802. The two listed substitutions cannot account for that discrepancy, leaving the evaluated-to-landing change understated.
findings.smallest_fix: Record the complete post-evaluation delta, recompute landing byte totals, and distinguish historical evaluation results from validation of the final text.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: the packet contains aggregate load and score counts but omits the referenced evaluation protocol, scoring criteria, exclusion records, and ordered run evidence. Loading in 27/28 runs does not establish loading before drafting; the same count could pass with the targeted ordering defect intact.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply bounded protocol and scoring excerpts, per-run load-versus-first-draft ordering, and exclusion evidence sufficient to verify the claimed behavioral correction.
